¢ Disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC) is a condition in which blood
clots form throughout the body, blocking small blood vessels. Symptoms
may include chest pain, shortness of breath, leg pain, problems speaking, or
problems moving parts of the body. As clotting factors and platelets are used
up “depleted”, bleeding may occur.
